content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire safety and building services contractor; target makes insulated piping products for energy and district heating projects."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes road-building and quarry machinery; target makes insulated piping systems for energy and district energy networks."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Water meters and utility data software; target makes pre-insulated piping for hot and cold fluid networks."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Diversified utility metering, test equipment, filtration and aerospace; no pre-insulated piping business matches the target."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of plumbing and waterworks products to contractors; target manufactures and engineers its own insulated piping systems."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Electrical contracting and installation for buildings and data centers; target makes insulated piping for district energy and pipelines."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and friction products; target makes pre-insulated piping systems and insulation, not fluid-handling equipment."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Coatings, sealants and roofing for buildings and consumers; target makes insulated pipe systems for energy networks."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Pumps and pump packages for water and petroleum; target makes pre-insulated piping systems, not pumping equipment."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Bearings and power transmission components; target makes insulated piping systems for district energy and pipelines."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Niche maker of heat tracing and insulation for process piping, with engineering and installation for oil, gas and energy plants."}]}
